description: net.Socket#resetAndDestroy() as Node 22's, on the socket that calls it: it returns the socket, destroys a connected socket at once with 'close' false, and waits for the connect on one still connecting; a socket without a connection gets ERR_SOCKET_CLOSED and a 'close' with no argument, and an already destroyed one nothing more; the peer of a socket that resets gets ECONNRESET from its read and 'close' true, also once it has read what was written (ai-ecoverse/slicc-jsh#966, slicc-kernel 1.155.0), and the peer of a destroyed one its end
